description: This file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractUnivariateStatistic' which implements core functionality for univariate statistical computations as per the 'UnivariateStatistic' interface. It manages internal data storage, validation, and evaluation methods meant to be specialized by subclasses.

classes.name: AbstractUnivariateStatistic
classes.description: An abstract class providing foundational implementation for univariate statistics, including data management, validation routines, and evaluation framework, to be extended by specific statistic implementations.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Stores a copy of the provided data array for statistical calculations.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns a copy of the stored data array.

methods.name: getDataRef
methods.description: Provides direct reference to the stored data array.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data array from a segment of the provided array, with validation.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the statistic based on the stored data array.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the statistic for the provided data array.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the statistic object.
